entries.title: SVF state projection and absorbing-state termination
entries.mechanism: Keep the exact first step, then project f/sh/vs/vb to building/vegetation/ever-visible Boolean state. After an ordinary step reaches building=1, vegetation=0, the final three masks are invariant to the remaining finite samples.
entries.admission_and_risks: No positive bush; no NaN/Inf or unsupported intermediate behavior; preserve initial correction and decode outputs as 1-B, 1-V, 1-(E-V). The combined output can be 2. Do not use this proof for wall-height outputs.
entries.cost_model: Sample ratio 1/(1-q+q*lambda), where q is original-work-weighted absorbing-ray share and lambda is the retained fraction. Add guards, branch cost and SIMD divergence. No-occlusion scenes may gain nothing.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Capture all three original outputs, first-step-only and two-step cases, adversarial corners, negative heights, bit masks; measure retained sample counts before timing.

entries.title: Certified non-contributing sky suffix
entries.mechanism: Bound every remaining building/canopy/trunk sample using exact stored decrements and source maxima. Retain the initial exceptional steps; stop only when the bound proves the complete visibility projection invariant.
entries.admission_and_risks: Include out-of-domain +0 padding, nonmonotone stored decrement suffix minima, dtype rounding and signed-zero effects. Use strict conservative bounds unless ties are proved. Positive-bush and wall23 require separate proofs.
entries.cost_model: Visits sum_x,p min(L_p, certified_cut_x,p) plus O(P*L) preparation and optional O(log L) per-pixel search. R01 and R02 share removed suffixes: combine cuts with min, never multiply gains.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Exhaustive small actual schedules and high-datum/low-obstacle scenes; compare certificate to exhaustive original traversal and count proof failures.

entries.title: Flat compiled hierarchy for provably irrelevant segments
entries.mechanism: Use conservative multi-resolution height bounds over the exact discrete source addresses, with a packed iterative traversal rather than Python object recursion.
entries.admission_and_risks: A bound must include boundary values and every live state update. Preserve equality operand selection and raw/nonfinite fallback. Existing oblique translated-horizon shortcuts are not equivalent.
entries.cost_model: B_build + N*(node_visits*c_node + evaluated_samples*c_step) < N*L*c_step. A hierarchy is useful only when enough samples are skipped to repay construction and cache misses.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Separate building13 research from the actual vegetation23 path; full return tuples, node/sample counters and flat-terrain negative controls.

entries.title: Hoist input-only global bush activation, then trace pixels independently
entries.mechanism: The global branch A_k=max_x([canopy_temp_k(x)>a(x)]*bush(x))>0 depends on immutable inputs and the schedule, not on f/vs/vb/g. Compute the exact flag sequence first; then replay each pixel recurrence using A_k without step-wide barriers.
entries.admission_and_risks: For finite bush, scan only bush>0 sites to decide positivity. Otherwise retain the original complete NaN-poisoning reduction. Keep all g updates and the bush tail; building absorption does not permit discarding live bush work.
entries.cost_model: Activation cost O(L*N_b) on the admitted sparse finite domain instead of O(L*N) global scans, plus pixel tracing. Compare added prepass cost with eliminated barriers and scans.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Exact activation bits and final masks against the original step-major positive-bush implementation; negative/zero/nonfinite bush cases and worker-count variation.

entries.title: Multi-state wall-shadow suffix certificate
entries.mechanism: Prove a suffix cannot increase the current building/vegetation maxima or alter canopy/trunk crossing states, including previous-step decrements; replay only the final unchanged wall calculations.
entries.admission_and_risks: Wall23 returns quantities, not just binary shadows. Its volumeveg, previous height and wall sun/shade outputs invalidate the simple SVF building-absorption rule. No admission without an all-output proof.
entries.cost_model: Possible O(N*L) to O(N*L_live); actual bound tightness and query overhead determine benefit. No forecast before a cut-length census.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All wall23 outputs at exact angular boundaries and trunk/canopy gaps; compare against exhaustive traversal, never a building-only surrogate.

entries.title: No-vegetation and uniform-region exact specializations
entries.mechanism: Specialize the executed vegetation path when exact input predicates establish absent canopy/trunk/bush or a uniform block. Eliminate only states proved observationally redundant.
entries.admission_and_risks: Calling wall13 instead of wall23 is not automatically correct: initial indices, schedule arithmetic, padding and returns differ. Keep the wall23 schedule and prove its specialized recurrence.
entries.cost_model: Reduces field loads and comparisons per sample; gains depend on admitted-area fraction and memory/compute bottleneck, not vegetation file existence.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Zeros, signed zeros, absent vegetation on rooftops, negative terrain and exceptional first steps; test all original return fields.

entries.title: Ray microtiles and active-lane SIMD
entries.mechanism: Run the original sample sequence over contiguous receiver lanes, with exclusive lane state. Batch rays/blocks to amortize launches; compact inactive lanes only if ownership/order remain exact.
entries.admission_and_risks: Irregular termination can waste vector lanes. Do not reorder samples within a receiver or infer translated-ray equivalence. Stage-global bush flags must already be established.
entries.cost_model: SIMD saves instruction overhead, but utilization approximately live_lane_steps/issued_lane_steps can dominate. Compare scalar early-exit versus SIMD masked execution, not only vector width.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Generated target assembly, lane utilization, exact serial/parallel comparisons; sparse and dense obstruction workloads.

entries.title: Reuse exact schedules and complete shadow dispatch
entries.mechanism: Reuse O(L) ray descriptors keyed by exact shape, scalar dtype/bits, family and termination policy; connect existing independent-pixel kernels to the admitted CPU budget where still serial.
entries.admission_and_risks: GVF addressing and some JIT caches already exist. Do not conflate sky and wall families, cache approximate angles, or count existing work as a new optimization.
entries.cost_model: Amortized preparation and startup reduction plus measured thread scaling. Larger CPU allocations are reported separately from equal-budget code improvements.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Fresh-process JIT cache tests, schedule hashes, original outputs, same total CPU reservation across worker configurations.

entries.title: Compiled outer blocks, ordered pixel SIMD, fused visibility consumption
entries.mechanism: Move block scheduling into native code; traverse patches in original order for each receiver while vectorizing independent pixels. Decode one patch microtile and immediately update accumulators rather than materializing four B-by-P float arrays.
entries.admission_and_risks: Preserve accumulator dtype, separate rounding nodes, scalar promotion, raw payloads, mapped-owner locks and exception preflight. Avoid too many live registers or hidden nested thread pools.
entries.cost_model: Workspace O(B*A+P) instead of O(B*P) for decoded cubes. Up to 32*N*P bytes of logical write/read for four float32 decoded arrays can be avoided per sweep, not necessarily DRAM bytes.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All SW/LW fields, mixed encodings, irregular final blocks, 1/multiple threads; assembly and per-memory-level traffic counters.

entries.title: Exact categorical partial evaluation
entries.mechanism: Evaluate the original typed expression E(coeff_t,p, discrete_state) for every allowed discrete state once per patch/timestep. Pixel kernels select that exact contribution and retain every original accumulation in order.
entries.admission_and_risks: Not a surrogate, interpolation or rounded-coefficient lookup. Tables store each separate contribution in its original dtype. Raw visibility and nonfinite-domain behavior retain an exact fallback.
entries.cost_model: Expression evaluations O(N*P*T) -> O(C*P*T), but selection/ordered additions remain O(N*P*T). Use stage fraction alpha and table overhead, not the N/C ratio, to predict stage speed.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All categories including combined=2, signed zero, 0*NaN, mixed scalar types and every original intermediate cast.

entries.title: Tile-lifetime tan(ASVF) and immutable angular factors
entries.mechanism: Compute the same profile tan32(asvf) and genuinely invariant patch/cardinal coefficients once at their valid lifetime, then reuse them across SW/LW and timesteps.
entries.admission_and_risks: Fallback NumPy vector/tail behavior can be layout-sensitive. Restrict to the certified SLEEF domain or preserve fallback layout. Solar coefficients and atan classifications remain dynamic.
entries.cost_model: One float32 plane costs 4*N bytes. Benefit T*c_tan*N minus build/load cost; must include added working-set pressure.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Exact profile keys, cache invalidation, unsupported dtype/layout tests and cold/warm timings.
entries.relation_to_previous: previously identified, not counted as new

entries.title: Classification over exact distinct ASVF bit values
entries.mechanism: Intern exact admissible ASVF bit patterns once per tile. For each timestep and patch evaluate the original classifier for U distinct inputs, then scatter classifications by IDs.
entries.admission_and_risks: Use bit identity, not tolerance, bins or decimal values. Signed zeros and NaN/raw classes require exact handling. Full classifier inputs, scalar dtype and math profile belong in identity.
entries.cost_model: O(N*P*T) transcendental evaluations -> O(U*P*T) plus O(N*P*T) cheap lookup/scatter. Benefit requires U much smaller than N and modest ID/table memory.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Unique-value census on real scenes; dense-random ASVF negative control; exact sun/shade equality including equality yielding neither class.

entries.title: Certified classifier threshold with uncertain-band fallback
entries.mechanism: For a patch/time classifier, derive an interval enclosure of the implemented typed tan/add/atan/degree pipeline. Return a Boolean only when the entire enclosure lies on one side; evaluate the original expression in the uncertain band.
entries.admission_and_risks: Real-number monotonicity alone does not certify rounded SLEEF monotonicity. Need a rigorous bound for the implemented profile or an admitted exhaustive float-domain certificate. Preserve separate < and >, equality and nonfinite cases.
entries.cost_model: New cost N*P*T*(c_compare + q_uncertain*c_original) plus certificate construction. Useful only if q_uncertain and certificate overhead are small.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Adjacent floats around both boundaries, exact-equality values, exhaustive certified domain or checked interval proof. Unsupported intervals always fall back.

entries.title: Exact visibility/classification signatures and ordered prefix sharing
entries.mechanism: Group receivers with identical complete inputs for a radiation subexpression, or share ordered-prefix accumulator nodes with identical incoming state and exact contribution sequence. Compute shared results once, then scatter.
entries.admission_and_risks: Visibility alone is insufficient when ASVF, Lup or material/temperature differs. Include all live inputs; verify hash collisions by byte equality. Bound trie/group memory and stop at the first pixel-dependent input.
entries.cost_model: Full-row grouping replaces N ordered reductions with U reductions plus O(N) scatter. Prefix sharing costs O(E) unique edges rather than O(N*P), but can be worse if E approaches N*P.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Measure signature entropy and group/trie construction; perturb each dependency and test state/outputs bitwise. No quantization.

entries.title: Fuse aniLum with compatible shortwave visibility work
entries.mechanism: Add a separate original-order aniLum accumulator to a traversal already reading the same visibility. Move it only across nodes with no data/state/error dependencies and retain the original multiplication/cast graph.
entries.admission_and_risks: Kdown consumes dRad; other radiation and ground-view stages have dependencies. This is not permission to reorder chronological state or share unrelated low-level diffsh objects.
entries.cost_model: Removes one independent visibility sweep and its materialization costs; derive combined work once with P01/P02, never multiply their savings.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Intermediate aniLum/dRad plus all output fields and state; independent dense diffsh fallback and scalar-type fixtures.

entries.title: Reuse longwave decode and specialize identical nocturnal components
entries.mechanism: Keep exact decoded categories or compact masks locally across the two required LW sweeps. Hoist nighttime coefficients that are exactly equal while retaining sky anisotropy and chronological updates.
entries.admission_and_risks: The reflected term uses completed sky accumulation and pixel Lup. Never replace LW with total SVF or skip nighttime. Cache keys include all coefficients and state-dependent inputs.
entries.cost_model: Reduces repeated decode/preparation and some coefficient arithmetic; two ordered mathematical sweeps may remain. Match emitted scratch to cache capacity.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Night/day transitions, low sun, varying Lup, leaf state, cloudy sky, SW-off but LW-active fixtures.

entries.title: Demand graph and admitted output-profile specialization
entries.mechanism: Construct backward liveness from all requested artifacts, public returns, carried state, validation/error effects and trace mode. Omit only truly dead intermediates; specialize common cylinder/flag paths while retaining every live radiation contribution.
entries.admission_and_risks: Do not skip physics because a diagnostic save flag is off. Keep full low-level return contracts and a full-trace execution path. Validation side effects and alias writes are observable sinks.
entries.cost_model: Work/bytes removed equal the proven dead subgraph, not an assumed output percentage. No saving in all-output/full-trace profiles where values remain live.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All seven workflows, each flag combination, state equality, low-level full returns, and errors. Audit backward-slice edges explicitly.

entries.title: Typed-profile specialization and optional native extension
entries.mechanism: Build lean common-profile kernels rather than repeated inspect.signature and generic wrapper dispatch; consider a small C/C++ SIMD extension only when generated-code evidence shows persistent Numba limitations.
entries.admission_and_risks: Preserve NumPy fallback, package portability, explicit SLEEF FMA and all original arithmetic nodes. A language rewrite alone is not a performance argument.
entries.cost_model: Reduces dispatch or poor machine-code overhead; include compilation, wheel distribution and instruction-cache costs in first-use evaluation.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Installed-wheel CPU-only tests, scalar/array dtype matrix, unsupported-profile fallback, LLVM/assembly evidence and same-host pairs.

entries.title: First-blocker prefix plus exact repeated-add replay
entries.mechanism: For finite binary building masks, precompute the first absorbing zero of f=min(f,b). Gather dynamic ground channels only before that blocker. Reconstruct continuing wall sums using tables A_c[n+1]=RN(A_c[n]+c), not n*c.
entries.admission_and_risks: Preserve persistent outside-slice samples, first-distance snapshots, all 16 intermediates and float32 count range. Nonbinary/nonfinite inputs and diverse per-pixel wall values retain fallback. Keep water source mutation separate.
entries.cost_model: Full N*D*R preparation plus T_d*N*D*(mean_prefix+h) instead of T_d*N*D*R, or skip static preparation for open scenes. O(N*D) blocker storage.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Exhaustive short binary paths, signed-zero/subnormal finite channels, first/second distances, water and no-occlusion negative controls.

entries.title: Prepare owned direction-invariant sources once
entries.mechanism: Hoist buildings/materials, aspect radians and eligible dynamic emission/albedo fields out of the 18-direction loop, maintaining explicit immutable snapshots.
entries.admission_and_risks: The first Lup is prepared before the upstream water Tg mutation; later directions may observe changed Tg. Keep first/later snapshots or fall back. Read-only views of externally mutable arrays are not ownership.
entries.cost_model: Six per-direction source copies alone imply 2*6*4*N*D*T_d logical bytes. Shared preparation can reduce D-fold repetition, but memory hierarchy determines elapsed benefit.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All original _sun/_gvf outputs and mutated Tg, aliases, water class, direction ties and fallback dtypes.

entries.title: Fuse gather and postprocessing; retain only live receiver fields
entries.mechanism: Consume gather sums in a block-local postprocessor and immediately update final total/cardinal outputs in original direction order; avoid writing 16 full intermediate planes.
entries.admission_and_risks: Keep each arithmetic/cast node, direction order, denominator conventions, keep masks and material mutation. Full intermediate tracing uses a diagnostic path.
entries.cost_model: Scratch O(16*N) -> O(A*B) for the affected stage; removes stores/loads but gather work may remain dominant.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Full intermediate comparison in diagnostic mode, all state and outputs in optimized mode, changed block size, parallel ownership and maximum RSS.

entries.title: Cache five static unshadowed-albedo GVF fields
entries.mechanism: Build total/cardinal unshadowed-albedo fields in the original ordered recurrence and reuse only under complete immutable geometry/material/search-distance identity.
entries.admission_and_risks: The complete GVF radiance is dynamic and cannot be cached as geometry. Invalidation must include albedo, input bits, logical boundary, scale and algorithm profile.
entries.cost_model: Win when T_d*C_static > B_build + T_d*C_read. Five float32 maps cost 20*N bytes (20 MiB at 1024 squared).
entries.smallest_discriminator: Perturb every dependency, compare exact maps and multi-day states, include first-use build time and additional memory.

entries.title: Compact ordered transport descriptors, not reassociated sparse matmul
entries.mechanism: Represent static blocker/face events and retained sample addresses compactly, then replay original ordered dynamic contributions. Share schedules and run boundaries instead of storing N*D*R full addresses.
entries.admission_and_risks: Standard CSR/BLAS/FFT may change floating-point grouping. Preserve out-of-slice history and each term/cast. Reject huge expanded index tables that exceed saved work.
entries.cost_model: Construction amortization versus eliminated address predicates; O(N*D) event data plus O(D*R) shared schedules is the preferred size target.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Count descriptor bytes, address operations and replay equivalence, including tiny tiles whose Python slices clip unusually.

entries.title: Exact material/shadow emission-state tables
entries.mechanism: Find repeated complete material/forcing/shadow input tuples for source emission expressions. Evaluate the original typed expression once per exact tuple and scatter the field.
entries.admission_and_risks: Use exact bit keys and all temperature parameters, shadow/transmittance values and first/later water state. Do not quantize Tg or merge nearby materials. Dynamic delayed radiance is not automatically categorical.
entries.cost_model: Expression cost O(N*T_d) -> O(U_material_state*T_d), plus O(N*T_d) scatter; useful only with low exact-state entropy.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Actual unique-tuple census; mixed materials, water, rare shadow states, signed zero and raw-value fallback.

entries.title: Interior addressing fast path and exact Boolean-channel counters
entries.mechanism: Use branch-free prevalidated source offsets in the interior and the exact boundary recurrence on edges. Replace Boolean 0/1 accumulation with counters only where the float32 sequence is exactly represented, then restore the original numeric value.
entries.admission_and_risks: No halo truncation or changed logical domain. Count limits matter: repeated float32 +1 does not equal casting arbitrary large integers. Weighted emission/albedo sums cannot become count*value.
entries.cost_model: Interior fraction approx (max(0,n-2r)/n)^2 on square tiles; counter savings depend on loop instruction mix. Boundary-heavy tiny tiles should use fallback.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Integer-range boundary, every edge/corner, zero/one-sample rays and exact intermediate counts.

entries.title: SVF patch consumption fusion with original annulus additions
entries.mechanism: Prepare scalar weight sequences once, reuse patch planes, accumulate all 15 SVFs per receiver in exact patch/annulus order and encode completed visibility without retaining float cubes.
entries.admission_and_risks: Do not sum annulus weights first or multiply an accumulated weight. The builder must own captured bytes before scratch reuse; preserve directional corrections and output order.
entries.cost_model: Reduces O(N*P*annuli) materialization passes without changing addition count; scratch reuse and SIMD across pixels can help cold geometry.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All 19 outputs, irregular patch tables, clipping, raw visibility, exact weight node rounding and full required exports.

entries.title: Block-local categorical/raw codec with uniform modes
entries.mechanism: Add versioned constant-payload and block-local binary/ternary/raw storage, or sparse raw-bit exceptions, so one exceptional sample does not force an entire patch raw.
entries.admission_and_risks: Preserve every float32 bit, reserved-code failures, signed zeros, NaN payloads and old cache/legacy NPZ interoperability. Compression may increase metadata and branch costs.
entries.cost_model: For raw fraction e, approximate payload categorical_bits*N/8 + e*N*exception_bytes + metadata instead of 4*N per affected patch. Evaluate actual e and decode access locality.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Round-trip arbitrary uint32 bit patterns, sparse/dense exceptions, mapped close/read races, corrupt metadata and output schemas.

entries.title: Intern identical payloads and uniform spatial blocks
entries.mechanism: Use hash-plus-byte comparison to share identical immutable encoded patch/block payloads or exact uniform regions; retain independent logical identities and masks.
entries.admission_and_risks: A hash is not an equality proof by itself. Do not merge nearly equal visibility or assume translated scene geometry has identical edge/solar behavior.
entries.cost_model: Benefit scales with duplicate payload fraction; hashing/metadata and random access can exceed storage savings. No gain expected for high-entropy scenes.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Duplicate-byte census, adversarial collisions, serialization round-trip and real decode throughput.

entries.title: Sparse wall/aspect evaluation and exact filter reuse
entries.mechanism: Reuse original rotated sparse filter offsets and evaluate only original wall locations. Improve layout and reuse while preserving angle order and strict score ties.
entries.admission_and_risks: A compiled sparse version may already exist. Audit before implementing; do not substitute gradient/Sobel orientations or change SciPy rotation semantics.
entries.cost_model: Costs scale with wall fraction and sparse filter cardinality, but filter construction and fallback-gradient work remain.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All wall/aspect fixtures, rotation ties, no-wall inputs and exact border behavior; cold preprocessing profile.
entries.relation_to_previous: existing family: only implement an identified residual

entries.title: Whole-stage out-of-core execution, not smaller model tiles
entries.mechanism: Keep logical geometry and state on bounded backing storage; use owner-compute receiver blocks that read the full required context and obey stage barriers. Bound physical working sets, not only decoded visibility.
entries.admission_and_risks: mmap is not a resident-memory guarantee. Long shallow rays can touch the whole domain. Never change solar location, meteorological aggregation, overlap or output extent through block size.
entries.cost_model: Capacity grows with active workspace rather than all tiles. Additional page faults/I/O can reduce throughput; report a capacity result separately from acceleration.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Adversarial long rays, 2048/default-3600 or resource-limit outcomes, dirty-page/RSS measurements, cross-block state equality.

entries.title: Geometry lifecycle reuse and efficient mandatory legacy export
entries.mechanism: Reuse the existing verified native geometry for repeated dates and stream legacy float32 members with bounded packing/compression work. Avoid regenerating identical immutable intermediates.
entries.admission_and_risks: Existing native cache already works. Required cold exports remain in cold timing; do not call skipped export work an exact default improvement. Verify complete dependency fingerprints.
entries.cost_model: Savings from avoided recomputation amortize across dates; export cost scales with the required serialized payload even when encoded native storage is small.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Cold/warm identical contracts, stale and corrupted caches, legacy consumer round-trips, cache-hit rates and export wall time.

entries.title: UTCI exact typed-DAG partial evaluation
entries.mechanism: Hoist weather-only typed subexpressions for uniform Ta/RH and reuse exact repeated powers/nodes without regrouping the polynomial. Compile the pointwise remaining DAG.
entries.admission_and_risks: The Horner rewrite previously failed its frozen gate. Do not reassociate terms, replace math profiles, clamp to a different validity range or make a new UTCI approximation.
entries.cost_model: Stage gain bounded by the weather-only fraction; UTCI has not been established as the dominant full-run cost. Profile before prioritizing.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Coefficient/source checksums, original term/cast behavior, adverse cancellation, missing inputs and final masks.
entries.relation_to_previous: residual of an already compiled family

entries.title: Evaluate terminal comfort only on valid receivers
entries.mechanism: For outputs that are replaced by a fixed invalid mask and do not feed state/neighbor calculations, compute terminal comfort only at valid receivers; scatter original invalid values.
entries.admission_and_risks: Invalid output receivers can still obstruct others and contribute model state. Never prune geometry, TMRT fields needed elsewhere, or validations based solely on the UTCI output mask.
entries.cost_model: Terminal comfort work scales with valid fraction v instead of 1, plus index/scatter cost. It gives no equivalent reduction in radiation or shadow work.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All output flags, invalid-mask equality, buildings with strong neighbor effects, sentinel/nonfinite error behavior.

entries.title: WBGT forcing preparation reuse without changing convergence
entries.mechanism: Reuse uniform wet-bulb input preparations and immutable scalar coefficients across equivalent timelines; fuse eligible pointwise globe/selection operations in their original typed order.
entries.admission_and_risks: Preserve array-wide stopping and iteration counts; independent per-pixel early convergence may change results. No scientific change to shade selection or pressure/temperature units.
entries.cost_model: Benefit depends on whether WBGT is requested and how much of its cost is repeated forcing versus spatial evaluation.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All solver branches and convergence/failure fixtures, scalar/array inputs, missing values and original shade condition.

entries.title: Exact forcing/solar preparation grouping
entries.mechanism: Group only tiles/dates with exactly identical complete forcing/solar-preparation keys; reuse timezone machinery and parsed meteorology while preserving per-tile location and aggregation.
entries.admission_and_risks: Same hour or same nearest station is insufficient. Include coordinates, date/UTC conventions, altitude quirks, units, averaging order, leaf schedule and optional UHI policy.
entries.cost_model: O(K*T) preparation -> O(U*T)+O(K) dispatch where U is exact-key count. Setup benefit can matter for many small tiles; do not assume it dominates 1024-square runs.
entries.smallest_discriminator: DST/date rollover, distinct centroids, aggregation identities, own-met/ERA5/WRF parity and invalidation.

entries.title: Load only selected directional wind planes
entries.mechanism: After validating the complete directional-input contract, load/mmap the direction bins actually used in the timeline and reuse them lazily under bounded ownership.
entries.admission_and_risks: Unused missing files must still produce the original validation outcome when the contract requires all 12. Preserve nearest-bin ties, wind-from convention and the existing floor.
entries.cost_model: Resident wind storage about 4*N*U_d instead of 4*N*12; input hashing/metadata validation costs remain. U_d=12 has no capacity saving.
entries.smallest_discriminator: All direction bins, ties, unknown directions, missing unused files, shape/CRS mismatches and concurrent close safety.

entries.title: Optional wind/input-construction common subexpressions
entries.mechanism: For optional wind preprocessing, reuse exactly matching rotations, connected-component geometry and morphology descriptors across directions; bound direction-worker memory and retain source APIs.
entries.admission_and_risks: Network acquisition is outside the local preexisting-TIFF target unless explicitly included. Preserve labels, boundary fill, interpolation, roughness policy and dependency isolation.
entries.cost_model: Only benefits runs actually requesting these workflows. Include preprocessing in the target when enabled; no credit from omitting it.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Original optional workflow comparisons, missing dependency behavior, directional symmetry traps and actual preprocessing profiles.

entries.title: Liveness-based memory admission with honest raw fallback
entries.mechanism: Model scene, state, real encoded payloads, per-stage peak workspace, native/JIT/GDAL caches and active writers. Admit jobs by simultaneous live bytes rather than summing mutually exclusive scratch.
entries.admission_and_risks: Do not replace worst-case accounting with two observed RSS samples, ignore mmap resident pages, or simply raise the RAM limit. Include a conservative safety reserve and out-of-core fallback.
entries.cost_model: Can permit larger W under the same physical budget. Memory saving is a scheduling enabler, not a multiplicative kernel speedup.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Actual allocations and process-tree memory under concurrent large/raw fixtures, bounded queue tests, failure before OOM and unchanged model outputs.

entries.title: Persistent bounded worker processes
entries.mechanism: Initialize one worker/JIT/math environment, process sequential independent tile jobs, release tile state/handles/locks after each, and reuse only bounded immutable runtime resources.
entries.admission_and_risks: No retained tile history or stale state. Avoid unsafe fork after native thread initialization; use supported process startup. Retire leaking/fragmented workers at safe job boundaries.
entries.cost_model: Reduces K*(import+JIT_load) to W*(import+JIT_load) plus task dispatch. Large-tile savings may be modest; compare actual startup share.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Multiple heterogeneous tiles, cancellation, worker death, memory plateau and one-owner file lifecycle.

entries.title: Joint worker/thread/microtile optimization
entries.mechanism: Select W,H,B under one CPU/RAM budget using measured concurrency curves and disjoint tuning scenes. Explicitly account for writer/compression threads and hybrid-core behavior.
entries.admission_and_risks: W*H is a reservation, not a promise that all cores are equivalent or fully busy. Changing resources is not a same-resource speedup. No tuning on final evaluation results.
entries.cost_model: Ideal X=C/(p+C*s/W) before contention; actual t_tile(W,H,B) decides. Share-memory saturation and tail imbalance can reverse the ranking.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Fixed-budget 1x8,2x4,4x2 or hardware-supported equivalents, real concurrent times, thermal/order controls and memory peaks.

entries.title: Memory-weighted longest-job-first tile scheduling
entries.mechanism: Use static input features or a calibrated cost estimator to order independent ready tiles, reducing the last slow-worker tail. Keep logical identities and final artifacts unchanged.
entries.admission_and_risks: Estimate only from tuning/calibration data. No priority policy may starve a tile, alter per-tile forcing, or bypass publication ordering requirements.
entries.cost_model: For heterogeneous jobs, greedy assignment can reduce makespan versus arbitrary order. Quantify idle-tail seconds; no benefit for identical jobs.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Unequal tile shapes/heights/vegetation, deterministic output mapping, fairness, cancellation and actual full-batch makespan.

entries.title: Stage-aware resource tokens and producer/consumer scheduling
entries.mechanism: Reserve resources separately for cold geometry, simulation and export; overlap independent tile stages while maintaining per-tile chronological and durability dependencies.
entries.admission_and_risks: Token acquisition must be deadlock-free, reserve transient memory and count native threads. No model timestep reordering. Static worker simplification may be faster to implement.
entries.cost_model: Steady-state throughput bounded by the slowest stage capacity, min_j(m_j/service_j), with startup/drain and shared bandwidth penalties.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Event-DAG validation, injected worker/writer failures, peak concurrent memory, no oversubscription and pipeline-drain latency.

entries.title: Bounded asynchronous single-owner writer
entries.mechanism: Overlap completed-buffer output writes with independent computation using explicit buffer ownership and a small queue; commit checkpoint cursor only after writes and required durability acknowledgments.
entries.admission_and_risks: Never overwrite a queued buffer, share writable GDAL datasets, skip readback/fsync, or silently accept writer failure. Writer CPU and buffers count toward budgets.
entries.cost_model: Can approach max(compute,write) rather than compute+write only when resources permit overlap. Extra copies may erase the benefit.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Backpressure, buffer-reuse corruption, writer exception propagation, crash at each commit boundary and byte/metadata equality.

entries.title: Content-addressed immutable checkpoint payload reuse
entries.mechanism: Reuse already durable unchanged state-map payloads across generations with generation manifests referencing immutable content; write and sync only new payloads while preserving every checkpoint boundary.
entries.admission_and_risks: Object identity/read-only flags are insufficient for mutable arrays. Prove owned versioned immutability or compare content. Keep corruption verification, GC pins, fsync and atomic cursor semantics.
entries.cost_model: State write bytes scale with changed distinct payloads rather than all state each step; hashing may still cost O(T*N). Most beneficial for unchanged nocturnal carried maps.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Interrupted reuse/publication/GC, content mutation, retained-reader lifetime, all state values and exact recovery at every original boundary.

entries.title: TIFF/NPZ packing and compression tuning with schemas intact
entries.mechanism: Batch writes to useful storage blocks; reuse bounded export buffers and benchmark compatible compression settings when binary layout is not an API contract.
entries.admission_and_risks: Preserve decoded pixels, metadata, filenames, bands and required cold exports. Include compression CPU and actual disk writes/reads. Do not mislabel a changed output workload.
entries.cost_model: Lower syscall/compression/packing overhead or physical bytes. Original float32 payload for 24x24x1024^2x10 outputs is 22.5 GiB before metadata, cache/export/checkpoints.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Legacy reader round-trips, filesystem failure, all metadata, full end-to-end equal-output timing and writer CPU accounting.

entries.title: Persistent JIT identity, bounded signatures and reusable scratch
entries.mechanism: Reuse verified compiled signatures and owned scratch inside persistent workers; compile unavoidable cold signatures once per appropriate cache identity and reserve JIT memory.
entries.admission_and_risks: Much JIT reuse already exists. No serial/parallel cache-key collisions, stale constants or platform-profile leakage. Warmup cost belongs inside first-use timing.
entries.cost_model: Eliminates residual compilation/allocations only where observed. Too many specialized kernels increase startup and instruction-cache footprint.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Fresh-process compile-order permutations, installed-wheel source hashes, read-only caches and first-use total time.

entries.title: Owned immutable input snapshots and shared verified preparation
entries.mechanism: Where the declared mutation contract permits it, read/verify input once into an owned immutable preparation object shared by independent consumers, avoiding duplicate parse/read/derivation.
entries.admission_and_risks: Do not replace content validation by mtime or remove input-change detection. Snapshot creation is timed; current public mutation/error semantics stay authoritative. Unsupported callers retain original checks.
entries.cost_model: Reduces duplicate reads/computation only if snapshot/verification cost is less than repetition. A memory mapping of a user-writable file is not immutable.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Input mutation at every validation boundary, failed snapshots, shared readers, file replacement and current exception contracts.

entries.title: Instrumented dispatch census, lean hot-path validation and evidence reuse
entries.mechanism: Collect cheap per-stage aggregate counters and validated feature flags once; avoid repeated introspection/type scans when owned inputs cannot change. Reuse source-keyed test evidence for unchanged components.
entries.admission_and_risks: Never delete validations with observable error behavior or reuse evidence after a dependency/profile change. Profilers do not run during final paired timings.
entries.cost_model: Reduces Python/dispatch overhead and developer/agent work. Numerical runtime and development-token savings are reported separately.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Validation-call coverage, adversarial mutations, source/dependency hashing and profiler noninterference.

entries.title: Fewer patches, pixels, timesteps or physical components
entries.mechanism: Coarsening, isotropic replacement, shorter arbitrary rays and vegetation simplification reduce the workload rather than optimize the same one.
entries.admission_and_risks: Requires an explicitly separate approximation product and scientific validation. Never promote as default compatibility optimization.
entries.cost_model: No speedup credited to the exact target.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Keep rejection visible in the ledger.

entries.title: Horner/reassociation, generic BLAS and angular moments without a new policy
entries.mechanism: Algebraic regrouping can preserve real-number equations while changing typed floating-point reductions. Previous Horner/moment experiments provide counterevidence.
entries.admission_and_risks: Default exact path disallows new reassociation/FMA/math-library substitutions. Existing frozen upstream tolerance is not permission to abandon a stronger candidate-to-candidate gate.
entries.cost_model: Any exploratory timing remains a separately authorized numerical-policy branch, not part of this goal.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Retain counterexamples and prior rejected experiments; do not relax gates.

entries.title: Prefix sums, integral images or FFT replacing ordered GVF reductions
entries.mechanism: Window sums can be faster over real numbers but subtraction/reordered summation generally changes float32 bits; occlusion and persistent edge samples also break simple convolution assumptions.
entries.admission_and_risks: Only a proved exact-domain specialization could leave quarantine. Integer Boolean counters within range are already covered by G07.
entries.cost_model: No assumed O(1) per-pixel gain in the exact policy.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Adversarial cancellation, boundaries and occlusion counterexamples.

entries.title: Parallel time scan or closed-form thermal recurrence
entries.mechanism: Affine scans/closed forms change intermediate rounding and often reset/branch behavior even when the real-valued recurrence is linear.
entries.admission_and_risks: Keep chronological state. A same-input/same-full-state memoization is possible but must replay all outputs and is not this shortcut.
entries.cost_model: No timeline-parallel speedup credited.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Find typed recurrence counterexamples and midnight/delay branch changes.

entries.title: Naive inverse-trig thresholds or approximate direction/ASVF bins
entries.mechanism: Replacing a rounded atan comparison with a real-number tangent inequality can flip decisions near the boundary; angle bins/quantization change exact ray sampling.
entries.admission_and_risks: Use P04 exact-value reuse or P05 certified bounds with fallback instead. Real monotonicity is insufficient.
entries.cost_model: No classifier speedup credited without a machine-level certificate.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Adjacent-float and equality tests against the pinned profile.

entries.title: Subtracting a terrain datum or replacing oblique sample sequences
entries.mechanism: Input height offsets and single-translation scan recurrences can change rounding, zero padding, termination and oblique discrete sample support.
entries.admission_and_risks: R02 proves noncontributing suffixes on original values instead. General horizon-scan reuse needs a new exact phase/sampling proof.
entries.cost_model: No height-range or O(N) horizon speedup credited merely from real geometry.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Signed-zero/negative-height/oblique counterexamples and previous failures.

entries.title: Relaxing checkpoint/hash/durability or dropping requested artifacts
entries.mechanism: Changing checkpoint frequency, omitting verification or exports, or weakening input identity can shorten runtime but changes the product/benchmark contract.
entries.admission_and_risks: Keep original durability and outputs by default. A user-approved optional policy is labeled and benchmarked separately.
entries.cost_model: No benefit counted in the equal-contract goal.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Run failure-injection and schema checks to expose silent policy changes.

entries.title: GPU/remote/hardware substitution or whole-program language rewrite as proof
entries.mechanism: Different hardware/resources or a language name alone does not establish faster local CPU execution of the same computation.
entries.admission_and_risks: Native hot kernels are allowed under P10 when justified; GPU/distributed execution needs separate scope and hardware reporting.
entries.cost_model: No unmeasured device/core-count multiplication.
entries.smallest_discriminator: Record actual hardware and resource envelopes.
